capabilities: Toggle a distraction-free window that hides the ribbon, tab bar, title bar and status bar
Enter and leave the mode with a configurable hotkey or tab-bar chevron
Choose which interface parts stay visible via Style Settings
Keep sidebars and workspace layout unchanged when leaving the mode
disambiguation: Not a standalone focus mode; it only adds the toggle command and chevrons, while the Fokus theme does the actual hiding.
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); the author notes phones and tablets already have a full-screen editor. No default hotkey is set to avoid clashes.
intentEvidence: A companion plugin for the Fokus theme.
problem: Obsidian's default window chrome (ribbon, tabs, sidebars, status bar) stays visible while writing, and no built-in switch hides it all at once.

relations.evidence: A companion plugin for the Fokus theme. One switch turns Obsidian into a quiet, distraction-free page
Style Settings | Optional; choose what the Fokus window hides

summary: Companion plugin for the Fokus theme that toggles a distraction-free window by hiding the ribbon, tab bar, sidebars and status bar.
